note: Guided demo script for the uncle/dad demo. All names fictional. 'kind' = teach | ask | small | restart. 'fact' on teach turns = the (subject, relation) the fair SmolLM prompt uses to mark a correction; 'correction': true means this fact replaces an earlier one. 'expect' = what a correct reply says; 'must' = key words a correct reply must contain (any-of groups); 'must_not' = words that make it wrong. Turns 28-32 are the visitor-improvises turns.

turns.expect: A friendly greeting; no fact saved.
Acknowledges; saves Juno's sister = Kim (or Kim sister-of Juno).
Acknowledges; saves Kim works at Brightwell Bakery.
Acknowledges; saves Lee lives in Oslo.
Oslo (two hops: Kim -> boss Lee -> lives in Oslo).
Saves TWO values: Norwegian and English.

turns.text: Actually, Lee moved to Bergen last month.
turns.expect: Updates Lee lives in Bergen, replacing Oslo; ideally says it replaced Oslo.
I don't know (never taught; must NOT guess Oslo/Bergen).

turns.text: What do you know about Kim?
turns.expect: Kim is Juno's sister, works at Brightwell Bakery, boss is Lee.
You (Juno) did / taught in this conversation.
A list of the taught facts: name Juno, sister Kim, Brightwell Bakery, boss Lee, Lee in Bergen, Norwegian+English.
Honest limits (e.g. only knows what it was taught, small vocabulary, no general knowledge).

turns.text: [restart: agent = new daemon on same state dir; SmolLM = empty context]
turns.expect: Agent keeps all facts; SmolLM has nothing.
No / I only know Norwegian and English / I don't know. Must NOT say yes.
